title: Friend-focused photo-sharing app Retro snags $21M | TechCrunch
summary: Retro , the friend-focused photo-sharing app built by former Instagram product engineers Nathan Sharp and Ryan Olson, has raised north of $21 million in Series A funding, according to an SEC filing .
